test_take_nd_fill_nonna: test algos.take_nd with fill_value that cannot be held and verify dtype conversion behavior
test_take_nd_2d_fill_nonna: test algos.take_nd on 2D arrays with fill_value along axis 0 and axis 1
test_take_nd_3d_fill_nonna: test algos.take_nd on 3D arrays with fill_value along each axis
test_take_nd_unsigned_int_cython: test algos.take_nd uses optimized Cython path for unsigned integer dtypes
test_take_allow_fill: test algos.take with allow_fill=True to replace negative indices with fill_value
test_take_bounds_check: test algos.take raises IndexError for out-of-bounds indices and ValueError for invalid negative indices
test_take_empty_array: test algos.take on empty arrays with empty indexer and non-empty indexer
test_take_coerces_list: test algos.take rejects list input and requires numpy.ndarray or ExtensionArray
